title: Federal Title I money for low-income pupils
question: How much federal Title I money was allocated to the district each year?
finding: Title I, Part A allocations to San Francisco Unified ran from $14,872,490 in 2017-2018 to $11,981,836 in 2021-2022. Nothing unusual shows in the trend; it is the baseline for the federal audit questions on the schools page.
how: U.S. Department of Education, ED Data Express, data group 797 (Title I Part A allocation), district line.
limits: Allocation, not spending. Pandemic relief money (ESSER) is not in these files. 2022-23 and 2023-24 files could not be downloaded.

sources.t: U.S. Department of Education, ED Data Express: Title I Part A allocations
